author: Haroen Viaene
subject: feat(SearchBox): add default width and height to buttons. (algolia/react-instantsearch#34)
bodyLines: Since svg allows a width and height attribute, we can use those to provide a default width and height. This has a lower specificity than css defined width or height, because it's an svg.
Especially the situation where people don't use the Algolia theme is improved by this.
